examples.text: pañcasu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, nikkhantāni kho, mārisā, pañcavassāni, ekaṃ dāni vassaṃ sesaṃ, ekassa vassassa accayena bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkh'uddesāyā'ti.

39902.meaning1: living for five hundred years; with a lifespan of five hundred years

examples.text: micchādiṭṭhiyā vepullaṃ gatāya tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu'pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo'pi parihāyi. tesaṃ āyunā'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañcavassasat'āyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu pañcavassasatikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā bhavissanti.

39905.meaning1: living for five thousand year; with a lifespan of five thousand year

examples.text: tesaṃ āyunā'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi parihāyamānānaṃ dasavassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañcavassasahass'āyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu pañcavassikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā bhavissanti.

39908.meaning2: five consciousnesses, eye, ear, nose, tongue, and body consciousness

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kammakāraṇaṃ karonti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiye hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiye pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ majjhe urasmiṃ gamenti.

saṃvaravinayo'pi hi sīlasaṃvaro, satisaṃvaro, ñāṇasaṃvaro, khantisaṃvaro, vīriyasaṃvaro'ti pañcavidho. pahānavinayo'pi tadaṅgappahānaṃ, vikkhambhanappahānaṃ, samucchedappahānaṃ, paṭippassaddhippahānaṃ, nissaraṇappahānan'ti pañcavidho.

tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kammakāraṇaṃ karonti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiye hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiye pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ majjhe urasmiṃ gamenti.
pañcapaññāsavassāni, yato nesajjiko ahaṃ, pañcavīsativassāni, yato middhaṃ samūhataṃ.
pañcavīsatime vagge paṭham'āpadāne bharitvā tuvaram'ādāyā'ti tuvaraaṭṭhiṃ muggakalayasadisaṃ tuvar-aṭṭhiṃ bhajjitvā pupphetvā bhājanena ādāya saṅghassa vanamajjhogāhakassa adadiṃ adāsin'ti attho.

39914.meaning1: knowing the five Vedas; bearing the five sacred Brahmanical scriptures; (comm) Vedas with the histories as a fifth

examples.text: pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
mātugāmo puriso ca, āveṇikā tidhammo ca, kodhano upanāhī ca, issukī maccharena ca, aticārī ca dussīlo, appassuto ca kusīto, muṭṭhassati pañcaveraṃ, kaṇhapakkhe pakāsito.

39916.meaningLit: discourse on five fears and enmities

39918.meaning2: five-constituent being, form-realm or sense-realm being

39920.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr pl of pañcahākāra

examples.text: tato paraṃ, pañcah'ākārehi anodhisopharaṇā sattah'ākārehi odhisopharaṇā dasah'ākārehi disāpharaṇā'ti ayaṃ vikubbanā, sukhaṃ supatī'tiādayo ānisaṃsā ca mettāyaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbā'ti.
adhammacuditassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno imehi pañcah'ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.

39921.meaning2: five acts that have immediate retribution, viz. matricide, patricide, murdering of a holy person, wounding a Buddha, and making a schism in the community of monks

39922.meaning1: five psychic powers; i.e. power of performing miracles, clairaudience, clairvoyance, knowing other's thoughts, and recollecting one's previous births
39922.meaning2: five physic powers, power of performing miracles, clairaudience, clairvoyance, knowing other's thoughts, and collecting one's previous births
39922.commentary: (APAa) pañc'ābhiññābalappatto'ti iddhividha-dibbasota-paracittavijānana-pubbenivās'ānussati-dibbacakkhu-saṅkhātāhi pañcahi abhiññāhi visesapaññāhi balasampanno, paripuṇṇo'ti attho.

examples.text: sīlavā vatasampanno, jhāyī jhānarato sadā, pañc'ābhiññābalappatto, suruci nāma tāpaso.

39923.meaning1: five bases; five grounds; (comm) five reasons
39923.commentary: (MNa) imān'eva pañc'āyatanānī'ti imān'eva pañca kāraṇāni. iti mātikaṃ ṭhapentena'pi pañc'eva ṭhapitāni, nigamentena'pi pañc'eva nigamitāni, bhājentena pana cattāri bhājitāni. diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ kuhiṃ paviṭṭhan'ti. ekattanānattavasena dvīsu padesu paviṭṭhan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā apar'antakappikā apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino apar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti, sabbe te imān'eva pañcāyatanāni abhivadanti etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ.

39925.meaning1: belonging to the Pañcāla people of northern India

examples.text: āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti… poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho pañcālacaṇḍo devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho pañcālacaṇḍo devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
sambādhe vā'pi vindanti (pañcālacaṇḍā'ti bhagavā), dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, ye satiṃ paccalatthaṃsu, sammā te susamāhitā'ti.

39928.meaningLit: belonging to the Pañcāla people; (or) Pañcālā's son
39928.commentary: (ANa) pañcālaputto'ti pañcālabrāhmaṇiyā putto. (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde magadharaṭṭhe maṇḍalikarājakule nibbattitvā visākho'ti laddhanāmo pañcālarājadhītuyā puttabhāvato pacchā pañcālaputto'ti paññāyittha.
39928.notes: Theragāthā verses 209-210 (TH2.45, TH165) are attributed to him.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti, poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya.

39929.commentary: (ANa) pañcālaputto'ti pañcālabrāhmaṇiyā putto. (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde magadharaṭṭhe maṇḍalikarājakule nibbattitvā visākho'ti laddhanāmo pañcālarājadhītuyā puttabhāvato pacchā pañcālaputto'ti paññāyittha.
39929.notes: Theragāthā verses 209-210 (TH2.45, TH165) are attributed to him.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā visākho pañcāliputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti, poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya.

39930.meaning1: name of a queen; (comm) the king of Pañcala's daughter

39932.meaning2: set of five weapons, viz. sword, spear battle-axe, bow and mace

39934.commentary: (THa) pañc'āh'āhaṃ pabbajito'ti pañc'āho ahaṃ, pabbajito hutvā pañc'āho, pabbajitadivasato pañcamo aho niṭṭhito'ti attho. sekho appattamānaso'ti adhisīlasikkhādīnaṃ sikkhanato sekho. anavasesato mānaṃ siyati samucchindatīti mānaso, aggamaggo, taṃnibbattito mānasato āgataṃ mānasaṃ, arahattaṃ, taṃ, so vā appatto etenā'ti appattamānaso. vihāraṃ me paviṭṭhassa, cetaso paṇidhī ahū'ti evaṃ sekhassa me vasanakavihāraṃ ovarakaṃ paviṭṭhassa sato evarūpo idāni vuccamānākāro cetopaṇidhi ahosi, evaṃ mayā cittaṃ paṇihitanti attho.

examples.text: pañc'āho-ahaṃ pabbajito, sekho appattamānaso, vihāraṃ me paviṭṭhassa, cetaso paṇidhī ahu.

39937.commentary: (MNt) pañca ahāni bhūtāni etassā'ti pañc'āhito, so eva vāro'ti pañc'āhikavāro. evaṃ satt'āhikavāro'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: tasmā pañcame vā sattame vā divase puna tattha cāretuṃ vaṭṭati, ettakena hi tiṇam'pi paṭiviruhati, udakam'pi pasīdati. ayaṃ pana imaṃ pañcāhikavāraṃ vā satt'āhikavāraṃ vā na jānāti, divase divase rakkhitaṭṭhāne'y'eva rakkhati.

39939.meaning1: going every five or seven days

39940.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pañcāha
39940.meaning1: once every five days; (comm) with five days in between
39940.construction:
pañca + aha + ika + aṃ
pañcāhika + aṃ

examples.text: pañc'āhikaṃ kho pana mayaṃ, bhante, sabbarattikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdāma. evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, appamattā ātāpino pahit'attā viharāmā'ti

39941.meaning1: which appeared on the fifth day; which becomes available on the fourth day after

examples.text: pañc'āh'uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.

39943.meaning1: five faculties (confidence, effort, mindfulness, meditative composure and understanding)
39943.commentary: (DNa) pañc'indriyānī'ti ādhipateyy'aṭṭhena ekalakkhaṇāni, adhimokkh'ādi-sabhāva-vasena nānāsabhāvāni. samathavipassanā-magga-vasen'eva ca lokiyalok'uttara-missakāni saddh'ādīni pañc'indriyāni desitāni.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc'indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjh'aṅgā, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo
ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañc'indriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni. katamasmiṃ ekadhamme? appamāde.

tassa tiṭṭhant'eva pañc'indriyāni yesaṃ avighātattā manāp'āmanāpaṃ paccanubhoti, sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. tassa yo rāgakkhayo, dosakkhayo, mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saupādisesā nibbānadhātu.
tiṭṭhanti kho pana, bhikkhave, tatth'eva pañc'indriyāni. ath'ettha sutavato ariyasāvakassa avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.

pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti.
pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, kāladānāni. katamāni pañca?
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, ām'āvasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.
pañca pañhā pañc'uddesā pañca veyyākaraṇānī'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

39949.meaningLit: five connected to the upper part
39949.commentary: (SNa) uddhambhāgiyānī'ti uparikoṭṭhāsiyāni. (SNt) uddhaṃ vuccati catasso arūpadhātuyo, vuttanayena taṃ bhajantī'ti uddhambhāgiyāni, saṃyojanāni rūp'ārūparāgamān'uddhacc'āvijjā.

examples.text: katamāni pañca? rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.

39950.meaning1: five heaps that are clung to; five grasping groups
39950.construction:
pañca + upādāna + khandha + ā
pañcupādānakkhandha + ā
39950.commentary: (KHPa) pañcā'ti gaṇanaparicchedo. upādānajanitā upādānajanakā vā khandhā upādānakkhandhā. yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ, vedanā, saññā, saṅkhārā, viññāṇañ'ca sāsavā upādāniyā, etesam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: so gacchati ce'pi ime pañc'upādānakkhandhe upagacchati. tiṭṭhati ce'pi ime pañc'upādānakkhandhe upatiṭṭhati. nisīdati ce'pi ime pañc'upādānakkhandhe upanisīdati. nipajjati ce'pi ime pañc'upādānakkhandhe upanipajjati.

jāti'pi dukkhā, jarā'pi dukkhā, maraṇam'pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'pi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogo'pi dukkho, piyehi vippayogo'pi dukkho, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ, saṅkhittena pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
kāmacchando ca byāpādo, thinamiddhañ'ca bhikkhuno, uddhaccaṃ vicikicchā ca, pañc'ete cittakelisā.

39954.meaning1: who has crossed five floods; who has traversed the deluge (of the five senses)

examples.text: evaṃvihārībahulo'dha bhikkhu, pañc'oghatiṇṇo atar'īdha chaṭṭhaṃ, evaṃ jhāyiṃ bahulaṃ kāmasaññā, paribāhirā honti aladdha yo tan'ti.

39955.meaning1: snared in five ways; trapped in five places
39955.commentary: (SNa) pañc'oḍḍito'ti pañcasu ṭhānesu kājadaṇḍakaṃ pavesetvā gahetabbā kājasikkā viya oḍḍito.

examples.text: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, makkaṭo pañc'oḍḍito thunaṃ seti anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.

39956.meaningLit: five connected to the lower part
39956.commentary: (AN 10.13) sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo, imāni pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi, āvuso, ariyasāvakassa pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti, atha khv'assa hoti, yo ca pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmī'ti māno, asmī'ti chando, asmī'ti anusayo asamūhato.
dasa'y'imāni, bhikkhave, saṃyojanāni. katamāni dasa? pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
sovaṇṇamayo pabhassaro, uppanno rathapañjaro mama, tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi, tena dukkhena jahāmi jīvitan'ti.

39959.meaning2: holding up the clasped hands as token of salutation
39959.commentary: (THa) pañjalīkatā'ti paggahitaañjalikā (THa) tattha kāyena kataṃ namakkāraṃ dassento pañjalī'ti vatvā

examples.text: sambuddhena kat'okāso, nisīditvāna pañjalī, ajito paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ, tattha pucchi tathāgataṃ.
allavatthā allasirā, sabb'eva pañjalīkatā, buddhassa pāde nipatitvā, idaṃ vacanam'abravuṃ.

39960.meaning2: holding up the clasped hands as token of salutation

examples.text: tam'enaṃ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya, ayaṃ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatū'ti.
no ce haritāni tiṇāni āmaseyyāsi, aggiṃ paricareyyāsi. no ce aggiṃ paricareyyāsi, pañjaliko ādiccaṃ namasseyyāsi
brāhmaṇā tisatā ime, yācanti pañjalīkatā, brahmacariyaṃ carissāma, bhagavā tava santike.
allavatthā allasirā, sabb'eva pañjalīkatā, buddhassa pāde nipatitvā, idaṃ vacanam'abravuṃ.

39962.meaning1: on course; going the right way
39962.commentary: (ANa) pañjasā'ti maggappaṭipannā, maggen'eva vāyanti, no amaggenā'ti attho.

examples.text: samaṃ utusaṃvaccharesu parivattantesu samaṃ vātā vāyanti samā pañjasā. samaṃ vātesu vāyantesu samesu pañjasesu devatā aparikupitā bhavanti.

39963.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, sapañña, sappañña

examples.text: tasmā hi dhīrañ'ca paññañ'ca bahussutañ'ca, dhorayhasīlaṃ vatavantam'ariyaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ sappurisaṃ sumedhaṃ, bhajetha nakkhattapathaṃ'va candimā.
sutavā nibbedhikapañño, sutavā nibbedhikapañño'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotī'ti

39965.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from paññā
39965.meaning1: state of understanding; fact of having wisdom
39965.commentary: (PM) mahāpaññatāya saṃvattantī'ti katamā mahāpaññā? mahante atthe pariggaṇhātī'ti, mahāpaññā.

examples.text: katame cattāro? sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahāpaññatā saṃvattantī'ti.

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi
āvasathapiṇḍo nāma pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ sālāya vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā ajjhokāse vā anodissa yāva'd'attho paññatto hoti.

39967.meaning1: (of a rule) formulated; prescribed; decreed; declared

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu'pi n'ātikkamanti
atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa etadahosi, bhagavatā paññattaṃ, na ekena dve sāmaṇerā upaṭṭhāpetabbā'ti.
ek'aṃsikā'pi hi kho, poṭṭhapāda, mayā dhammā desitā paññattā, anek'aṃsikā'pi hi kho, poṭṭhapāda, mayā dhammā desitā paññattā.

pūraṇena, bhante, kassapena chaḷabhijātiyo paññattā, kaṇh'ābhijāti paññattā, nīl'ābhijāti paññattā, lohit'ābhijāti paññattā, halidd'ābhijāti paññattā, sukk'ābhijāti paññattā, paramasukk'ābhijāti paññattā.
puggal'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno ayaṃ ukkhittako vā vambhito vā garahito vā, imassa vacanaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī'ti anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

39970.meaning1: what are called the prescribed training rules

39971.meaning1: excellent seat prepared for the Buddha
39971.meaning2: excellent seat prepared for the Buddha

examples.text: catutthe addasā'ti gaṅgātīre paññattavarabuddh'āsane nisinno addasa. vuyhamānan'ti caturassaṃ tacchetvā pabbat'antare ṭhapitaṃ vāt'ātapena suparisukkhaṃ pāvussake meghe vassante udakena uplavitvā anupubbena gaṅgāya nadiyā sote patitaṃ tena sotena vuyhamānaṃ.

39972.meaning1: what is assigned and what is not; designated and undesignated

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato sen'āsanapaññāpako na sammannitabbo … paññatt'āpaññattaṃ na jānāti … sen'āsanapaññāpako sammannitabbo … paññatt'āpaññattaṃ jānāti ….

39974.meaning1: name; designation; concept; description (of); what is called

examples.text: yehi, ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho rūpakāye adhivacanasamphasso paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
phassapaññattiyā sati vedanāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati
so tāya dhammapaññattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu paññattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.

39977.meaning1: pathway of description; mode of designation; way of stating

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi. katame tayo?

39978.meaning1: who teaches a lot; who is devoted to teaching

examples.text: so tāya dhammapaññattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu paññattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
iti kho, bhikkhu, desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.

39981.grammar: prp of paññapiyati, caus, pass, intrans (+instr)
39981.base: √ñā + āpe + iya > ñāpiya > ñapiya (caus, pass, irreg)

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tam'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kin'ti karomi!

39982.meaning1: should be defined; should be described; should be explained
39982.meaning2: should be taught; should be explained
39982.meaningLit: to cause to be actively known

examples.text: te ca aññatitthiyā paribbājakā aññavihitakena ñāṇadassanena aññavihitakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ maññanti yatha'r'iva bālā abyattā. atītaṃ kho, cunda, addhānaṃ ārabbha tathāgatassa sat'ānusāri ñāṇaṃ hoti, so yāvatakaṃ ākaṅkhati tāvatakaṃ anussarati.

evaṃ kusal'ākusala-sāvajj'ānavajja-sevitabb'āsevitabba-hīnapaṇīta-kaṇhasukka-sappaṭibhāgānaṃ dhammānaṃ paññapetāraṃ iminā'p'aṅgena samannāgataṃ satthāraṃ n'eva atīt'aṃse samanupassāma, na pan'eta'r'ahi, aññatra tena bhagavatā.
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti

kena loko litto saṃlitto upalitto kiliṭṭho saṃkiliṭṭho makkhito saṃsaṭṭho laggo laggito palibuddho, brūsi ācikkhasi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivarasi vibhajasi uttānīkarosi pakāsesī'ti, kiss'ābhilepanaṃ brūsi.
sant'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti. santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sīlavisuddhiṃ ce, āvuso, bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññapeyya, saupādānaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññapeyya.

39986.meaning1: (of a seat, water, etc.) prepares; sets out
39986.meaning2: (of a seat, water, etc.) prepares; sets out; lit. causes to know

examples.text: idha, bhante, amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati so āsanāni paññapeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhāpeti
tena hi, samma dovārika, majjhimāya dvārasālāya āsanāni paññapehī'ti.

39987.meaning1: to define; to delineate; to describe

examples.text: sakkā nu kho, bho gotama, imasmim'pi dhammavinaye evam'eva anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññapetun'ti?
na kho, āvuso gotama, āciṇṇaṃ nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa kammaṃ, kamman'ti paññapetuṃ. daṇḍaṃ, daṇḍan'ti kho, āvuso gotama, āciṇṇaṃ nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa paññapetun'ti.

39988.meaning1: (of a seat, water, etc.) having prepared; having set out; having laid out

examples.text: pupph'āsanaṃ paññapetvā, sādhucittaṃ manoramaṃ, narasārathinaṃ aggaṃ, idaṃ vacanam'abraviṃ.

tassa heṭṭhā kumārassa sayanaṃ paññapetvā upari suvaṇṇatārakakhacitaṃ vitānaṃ bandhāpetvā sāṇipākārena parikkhipāpetvā ārakkhaṃ ṭhapetvā rājā sabb'ālaṅ'kāraṃ alaṅ'karitvā amaccagaṇaparivuto naṅgalakaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ agamāsi.

39989.meaning2: (of a rule) proscribing; regulating; laying down

39990.meaning1: prepared; arranged; set out (a seat, water, etc.)

examples.text: app'ekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ, app'ekacce āsanaṃ paññapesuṃ, app'ekacce pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ. api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā, eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññapesi, eko pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhāpesi

39991.construction:
pa + √ñā + ā + vant + a
paññavant + a
39991.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, sapañña, sappañña
39991.notes: form of paññavant only found in doggerel verse

examples.text: vidhā cakkavatti māro, duppañño paññavena ca, daliddo adaliddo ca, ādiccaṅgena te dasā'ti.

39992.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paññāṇavant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññū, sapañña, sappañña
39992.commentary: (SNa) paññavatā'ti tam'pi sappaññen'eva paṇḍitena. (ANa) paññavanto… ettha kammassakatapaññā, jhānapaññā vipassanāpaññā, maggapaññā, phalapaññā'ti etāhi samannāgatā paññavanto nāma

examples.text: na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.
yo sīlavā paññavā bhāvit'atto, samāhito jhānarato satīmā, sabbassa sokā vigatā pahīnā, khīṇ'āsavo antimadehadhārī.

39994.meaning1: wisdom; knowledge; understanding; insight; distinctive knowledge
39994.synonym: anubodha, cakkhu, ñāṇa, pajānanā, paññāṇa, bojjha, mona, vijjā, veda
39994.commentary: (PMa) paññā'ti ca tassa tassa atthassa pākaṭakaraṇasaṅkhātena paññāpan'aṭṭhena paññā, tena tena vā anicc'ādinā pakārena dhamme jānātī'ti'pi paññā. (ITIa) pakārehi jānāti yathāsabhāvaṃ paṭivijjhatī'ti paññā.

examples.text: saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.
n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajhāyato, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.

39995.grammar: fem, instr sg of paññā, irreg
39995.meaning1: with wisdom; with intelligence; with understanding
39995.construction:
pa + √ñā + āya > ā
paññā + āya > paññā

examples.text: ānaṇyasukhaṃ ñatvāna, atho atthisukhaṃ paraṃ, bhuñjaṃ bhogasukhaṃ macco, tato paññā vipassati.

39996.meaning1: talk on understanding; discussion about insight

examples.text: appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.

39997.meaning1: category of wisdom; group of understanding

examples.text: yo ca sammāvāyāmo yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāsamādhi ime dhammā samādhikkhandhe saṅgahitā. yā ca sammādiṭṭhi yo ca sammāsaṅkappo, ime dhammā paññākkhandhe saṅgahitā'ti.
katamāni cattāri? idh'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi ekacce khattiyapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe, te bhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.
